message.text: Review policy and standards changed in this revision.

explanation.what: This revision changes AGENTS.md, which steers how Melian reviews this repository.
explanation.whatToDo: Have a maintainer read the change to AGENTS.md before merging.
explanation.whyHere: Melian reviewed the revision under the policy and standards it changes, so nothing it ran judged the new ones.

snippet.text: AGENTS.md's Who does what and Ready and queued now name the five things the coordinator may do in the maintainer's place: read a policy notice on a file it has read, dismiss an equivalent mutant, dismiss a finding that restates a ruling, dismiss a refuted injection flag on Melian's own prompt text, and post the override status under four conditions. [The decision](../decisions/2026-11-28-what-the-coordinator-may-do-for-the-maintainer.md) says why and quotes each delegation.

snippet.text: 4. **Dismiss a refuted injection flag on Melian's own prompt text that only moved**: a `melian/injection-attempt` finding the verifier refuted, where every flagged line is Melian's own prompt or its instructions for reviewers and is identical to a line already on the default branch. The test is a comparison of text, never the coordinator's judgement of meaning: a flag on any line the change wrote or reworded stays the maintainer's. The maintainer ruled this on 2026-11-28, in the coordinator's session, after the first round on this decision's own pull request.
